intro: Across 87 articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-07-31, ZCyberNews tracked supply-chain incidents spanning technology, software development, cryptocurrency, logistics, and manufacturing sectors globally, with particular focus on North America, Europe, Asia, and the United States. The coverage included 15 critical, 51 high, 16 medium, and 4 informational severity findings. Threat actors Lazarus Group, TeamPCP, and CanisterSprawl were observed in these campaigns. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-1731, CVE-2026-45033, CVE-2026-39987, CVE-2026-41650, and CVE-2026-44664, with the first two carrying CVSS scores of 9.8.
